inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Open questions about your data and proposed flight updates, in one place.

flightUpdates.title: Flight updates
flightUpdates.description: Changes to your flights proposed by an API.

review.title: To review
review.description: Two pieces of information disagree on these records. We change nothing — you decide.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.description: Nothing is open right now: no contradictions and no questions about time.

time.title: Questions about time
time.description: Something is missing here to show a time correctly: the place's time zone, the time of day or the exact day. We don't guess — add it if you know it, or leave it as it is.

home.title: Home
home.description: Your home is not fully set up yet. Nothing changes until you confirm it.

records.title: Check entries
records.description: Duplicate, overlapping or incomplete entries. We change nothing — you decide.

photoJourneys.title: Photo journeys
photoJourneys.description: Bursts of photographs that no recorded travel explains. Suggestions — only your answer turns one into an entry.
photoJourneys.thumbAlt: Preview {{position}} of this burst of photographs

creates.trip: Accepting creates a trip covering these dates.
creates.placeVisit: Accepting records a visit to this place on the first day.
creates.stayAnswerOnly: Accepting only marks the question answered. A stay needs a lodging this finding does not name — you create that yourself.
creates.placeMissingAnswerOnly: Accepting only marks the question answered. The place this finding named no longer exists — nothing is created.

empty.title: No suggestions
empty.description: Your photographs currently say nothing your logbook does not already record.

noImmich.title: No photo library connected
noImmich.description: Photo journeys read your own Immich library — the images never leave your machines.
noImmich.banner: Connect Immich and the search can run.

messages.noImmich: No photo library is connected — nothing was searched.

accepted.none: Marked as answered. Nothing was created.

messages.dismissed: Dismissed. This burst will not be suggested again.
messages.photosNotLinked: The photos could not be linked – the photo library could not be reached.
messages.scanOutcomeUnknown: The server no longer reports how the photo search ended. Shown is what has been found so far.

errors.loadFailed: The photo suggestions could not be loaded.
errors.acceptFailed: The suggestion could not be accepted.

acceptLinkFailed.trip: The trip was created, but the suggestion could not be marked as accepted — trying again only links it.
acceptLinkFailed.placeVisit: The visit was recorded, but the suggestion could not be marked as accepted — trying again only links it.

errors.dismissFailed: The suggestion could not be dismissed.

review.title: Visit suggestions from your trips
review.description: Photos taken during a recorded trip at a spot with no visit. Select several and accept or reject them together; place, name and time can be corrected first. Rejected suggestions do not come back.
review.unnamedSelected: {{count}} selected suggestion has no name yet — enter one under “Correct” or pick one of your places.
review.unnamedSelected_other: {{count}} selected suggestions have no name yet — enter one under “Correct” or pick one of your places.
review.nameNeeded: The lookup found nothing named here — enter a name under “Correct” or pick one of your places.

reason.noNearest: no logged visit in this trip

review.alreadyVisited: Since the scan, “{{name}}” was logged right next to it on the same day. Accepting would record the stop twice — reject it, or pick that place under “Correct”.

correction.placeNew: Suggested is a new place at this spot. Or pick one of your places:
correction.placeOwnSuggested: Suggested is your own place right next to it. Or pick another:
correction.name: Name of the place
correction.timeUnavailable: No time zone is known for this spot — the visit is recorded at the first photo's time.

review.requestFailed: The server's answer did not arrive — it is unclear which suggestions were saved. The list was reloaded; whatever is still there is open.

failure.NOT_A_VISIT: only visit suggestions can be accepted here.
failure.VISIT_NAME_REQUIRED: the place needs a name — enter one under “Correct”.
failure.VISIT_PLACE_NOT_FOUND: the chosen place no longer exists — pick another under “Correct”.
failure.TIME_INVALID: the time could not be read at this place (for example a clock time that does not exist because of a DST change).
failure.INTERNAL: unexpected error on the server — please try again.

creates.newPlace: Accepting creates the place and records a visit in the trip — at the time of the first photo unless you correct it.
creates.ownPlace: Accepting records a visit to your own place right next to it in the trip — the place already exists.
creates.chosenPlace: Accepting records the visit at “{{name}}”; no new place is created. If it already has a visit that day, the suggestion is linked to it.

messages.resolved: Thanks — we will look at this record again on the next run.
messages.dismissed: Understood. This question will not be asked again.

errors.loadFailed: The open questions could not be loaded.
errors.resolveFailed: Your answer could not be saved.
errors.dismissFailed: Your answer could not be saved.
errors.runFailed: The check could not be started.

tripSuggestions.title: Trip suggestions
tripSuggestions.description: Derived from your entries: when you were away and what belongs together. Suggestions only — nothing is created or linked until you accept.
tripSuggestions.capped: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} suggestions — answer some and the next ones move up.
tripSuggestions.truncated: Your logbook is larger than one analysis reads. Some suggestions may be missing.
tripSuggestions.zoneUnknown_one: {{count}} entry has no known time zone for its place — its day may be off by one.
tripSuggestions.zoneUnknown_other: {{count}} entries have no known time zone for their place — their day may be off by one.
tripSuggestions.tourNote: Day tours without a trip are linked too; tours that already belong to a trip stay where they are.

reason.placeVisit: You were here that day: “{{anchor}}” was {{distance}} m away.

signals.home_loop: out and back from your home airport

creates.new_trip: Accepting creates the trip and links every entry listed.
creates.assign: Accepting links the listed entries to this trip.
creates.extend: Accepting links the entries and sets the trip's dates to the new span.
creates.place_visit: Accepting records a visit on that day.

home.missing: No home airport set — without a home there is no telling when you were away. Only trips your flights themselves form are suggested.
home.estimated: No home airport set: your most-flown airport counts as home.

empty.title: No trip suggestions
empty.description: Everything that belongs together is already in a trip. New entries are checked here.

messages.dismissed: Dismissed. This suggestion only returns if its entries change substantially.

errors.loadFailed: The trip suggestions could not be loaded.
errors.loadFailedHint: That does not mean there are none. Try again in a moment.
errors.acceptFailed: The suggestion could not be accepted. Nothing was changed.
errors.dismissFailed: The suggestion could not be dismissed.
errors.stale: The suggestion has changed in the meantime — an entry was moved or deleted. Nothing was changed; the list has been reloaded.
errors.selection: The selection does not match the suggestion. Nothing was changed.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start.

workspace.title: Overview
workspace.heading: Open questions and suggestions
workspace.intro: Questions and suggestions with evidence and editable fields. Choose the view that suits your task.
workspace.laterHint: These items are deferred for this visit only. No data has been changed.
workspace.loadFailed: Some sections could not be loaded:
workspace.checkFailed: The check failed. Please try again.
workspace.incomplete: This overview is incomplete. Retry the missing sections.
workspace.noMatches: No matching items. Change the search or filter.
workspace.empty: All loaded questions and suggestions are resolved.
workspace.questionHint: This is an open question. The records have not been changed.
workspace.invalidDates: Choose valid dates: the end cannot precede the start.
workspace.tripEffect: Changes only the trip dates. Linked entries keep their dates. The question is then checked again.
workspace.numberEffect: Adds this flight’s number, then checks the question again.
workspace.flightEffect: Applies the displayed changes to this flight. Review the values before saving.
workspace.expired: This proposal has expired. Please refresh the inbox.
workspace.photoEvidence: {{photos}} photos, {{located}} with a location. They are evidence of a possible visit.
workspace.completeFields: Please complete the name and required dates.
workspace.photoLinkFailed: The entry was created, but linking failed. Accepting again links the same entry.
workspace.saveFailed: The action could not be confirmed. Your edits have been kept. Check the current state before retrying.
workspace.savedCheckFailed: Saved. The subsequent check failed; choose “Recheck records”.
workspace.staleSource: This section could not be refreshed. Reload it before saving a decision.
workspace.recordedContext: Show recorded flights, stays and stops
workspace.contextFailed: Could not load the trip timeline.

location.question: Were you in {{country}}?
location.evidence: TravTrack saw you on the ground in this country on {{days}} days ({{points}} positions), from {{first}} to {{last}}. Your passport does not know the country yet.
location.partial: On at least one of these days not every position was read.
location.effect: “Visited” and “Only passed through on the ground” save your own verdict on this country in the passport. “Not there” changes nothing, and these days are not asked again.
location.ground: Only passed through on the ground
location.emptyDescription: A question appears here once TravTrack sees you on the ground on at least two days in a country your passport does not know yet.

errors.invalidated: The location data behind this question was deleted or changed meanwhile. The question no longer applies.
errors.busy: Your answer is still being saved. Please try again in a moment.
errors.disabled: TravTrack is switched off on this server. The question stays; you can still choose “Not there”.

proposal.new_trip: These entries may form a trip
proposal.assign: {{count}} entries may belong to this trip
proposal.extend: Entries fall outside the trip dates
proposal.assign_one: One entry may belong to this trip
proposal.assign_other: {{count}} entries may belong to this trip

dismissProposal.new_trip: These do not form a trip
dismissProposal.assign: Does not belong to this trip

acceptPhoto.stayAnswerOnly: Acknowledge · does not create a stay
acceptPhoto.placeMissingAnswerOnly: Acknowledge · does not create a visit

workspace.recordLoadFailed: Could not load this entry. Please retry.
workspace.gpsProposal: Add a possible stay from GPS data

history.title: Already answered
history.empty: You haven't answered anything here yet.
history.failed: The answered items could not be loaded.

flag.unreadable: This version of the interface does not know this question yet. You can still answer it.
flag.neitherIsCorrect: Neither value is marked as the correct one. Nothing on the record was changed, and it keeps counting exactly as before.

resolve.label: I have corrected it
resolve.hint: You changed the record. If the contradiction is still there afterwards, we will ask again.

dismiss.label: This is correct as it is
dismiss.hint: There is nothing to change on the record. This question will never be asked again.

flag.timeUnchanged: Nothing was changed on the entry. The time stays as it was stored until you fill it in.
flag.recordUnchanged: Nothing about the entry was changed, and it keeps counting as before.

address_country_mismatch.title: Country disagrees with the address
address_country_mismatch.question: The address names a different country from the one stored. Which one is right?

undated_country_evidence.title: Country with no dated evidence
undated_country_evidence.question: {{country}} appears only on records that carry no date. Were you there?

stay_dates_reversed.title: Check-out before check-in
stay_dates_reversed.question: The check-out date lies before the check-in. Both dates are stored exactly like this — which belongs where?

coordinates_outside_country.title: Coordinates fall in another country
coordinates_outside_country.question: The stored coordinates fall inside a different country than the one on the record. Which is right – the point or the country?

time_zone_unresolved.title: Time zone unknown
time_zone_unresolved.question: No time zone could be found for this time, so the migration did not convert it. Where was this? Fill in the place – then the time of day is right too.

time_precision_unknown.title: Time of day unknown
time_precision_unknown.question: The date is kept, but it could not be established at what time of day this was. If you know it, enter it.

time_day_ambiguous.title: Day uncertain
time_day_ambiguous.question: It is not certain which calendar day is meant. The stored day was kept – check it and correct it if needed.

home_residence_unconfirmed.title: Confirm residence
home_residence_unconfirmed.question: Confirm where you live and pick further home airports?
home_residence_unconfirmed.body: So far TravStats only knows your home airport ({{airports}}) and measures distances from there. Confirm where you live and pick up to three airports you fly from.
home_residence_unconfirmed.unchanged: Until you confirm, every statistic stays exactly as it was.

duplicate_candidate.title: Possible duplicate
duplicate_candidate.question: This entry looks like a second copy of another — the same {{fields}}. Is it the same journey twice?
duplicate_candidate.safePath: If so: open the extra copy, delete it there, then tap “I have corrected it”. If these are two real entries, tap “This is correct as it is”.

chronology_conflict.title: Entries overlap
chronology_conflict.questionFlight: This flight departs {{minutes}} minutes before the previous one has landed. Both cannot be right — which time is wrong?
chronology_conflict.questionStay_one: This stay shares {{count}} night with a stay at another lodging. Which dates are right?
chronology_conflict.questionStay_other: This stay shares {{count}} nights with a stay at another lodging. Which dates are right?
chronology_conflict.safePath: Correct the time or date on the wrong entry. If both are right (two paid lodgings, say), tap “This is correct as it is”.

flight_number_missing.title: Flight number missing
flight_number_missing.question: No flight number is stored for this {{airline}} flight. Do you know it?
flight_number_missing.safePath: Enter it on the flight. If there is none (a charter without one, say), tap “This is correct as it is”.

airport_unknown.title: Unknown airport
airport_unknown.question: The catalogue does not know this airport code. A typo — or an airfield the catalogue is missing?
airport_unknown.safePath: Pick the airport again on the flight. If the code is right, tap “This is correct as it is”.

trip_end_missing.title: Trip without an end
trip_end_missing.question: This trip starts on {{start}} but has no end. When did it end?
trip_end_missing.suggestion: The last linked entry ends on {{day}}.
trip_end_missing.safePath: Enter the end on the trip. If it is still going, tap “This is correct as it is”.

trip_entries_outside.title: Entries outside the trip
trip_entries_outside.question: These entries belong to the trip ({{span}}) but fall outside its days. Are the trip dates right — or does the entry belong to another trip?
trip_entries_outside.safePath: Adjust the trip dates or move the entry to another trip.

passwordResets.title: Password reset requested
passwordResets.description: This instance cannot send e-mails, so anyone who forgot their password ends up here instead of in a mailbox.
passwordResets.handleFailed: The request could not be marked as handled.

unfiledDocuments.title: Documents filed with nothing
unfiledDocuments.description: These uploads do not belong to an entry. File them with a flight, cruise, stay, place or trip — otherwise they are deleted, file and all, {{days}} days after they came to belong to nothing.

time.noEditor: The entry this could be edited through can no longer be found.
time.domainOff: The “{{domain}}” area is switched off. Switch it on in the settings to answer this question.
